run_train_from_folder: run the part generator training loop on a dataset folder with configurable hyperparameters
run_generate_samples: run sample image generation using a trained DoodleRAGAN model with timestamped output
run_resume_training: run training from a previously saved checkpoint by specifying the load_from step number
run_new_training: run a fresh training session by clearing previous model state with the new flag
run_configurable_training: run training with custom batch size, learning rates, image size, and sparsity penalty settings
